document.abstract: In considering past activities, present program and the future policy of the Papers Committee, the members of this Committee have many times discussed the advisability of a complete educational program for the projectionist. With the diversified program which has been arranged for this convention, it seemed the proper time to suggest the consideration of such educational activities of the Society.
